|lore=Veteran officer of the Old Republic who retired from active duty after the Clone Wars. Makes a living in the Outer Rim Territories passing on his scouting expertise.
|game_text=Deploy on your scout (except Luke). If scout (or starship they are aboard) was just targeted by a weapon, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel that targeting.
|printings={{Card versions/Solomahal (A New Hope)}}
|notes=The 2006 slip names the scout and their starship in the response to a weapon that just targeted one of them. The [[Solomahal (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the consolidated PDF made in February 2003. The sheet gives 20 September 2002 as the set’s tournament-legality date, and the complete set was available by 21 September. The [[Solomahal (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 21. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
